children.text: Register on the
SUGAM portal
and log in using your credentials.
Select the Bursary Scheme from the available schemes on the dashboard.
Click “New Application”, choose the applicable academic year, and create a new application.
Fill in the required personal details and proceed to the next section.
Enter your address details and provide information on past and current academic qualifications. Upload the bonafide certificate.
Enter fee details and upload the fee receipt and textbook fee receipt (if applicable).
Provide parent/guardian details, family annual income information, and upload supporting documents such as income certificates and death certificates (if applicable).
Enter bank account details and upload the required banking and identity documents.
Complete the undertaking by downloading it through the e-sign process using Aadhaar authentication, then upload the signed undertaking.
Preview the application, submit it online, and receive a confirmation email upon successful submission.
NOTE:
Student User Manual
to know more about the application process.

applicationProcess.process_md: - Register on the [SUGAM portal](https://sugam.gshec.edu.in/) and log in using your credentials.- Select the Bursary Scheme from the available schemes on the dashboard. - Click “New Application”, choose the applicable academic year, and create a new application. - Fill in the required personal details and proceed to the next section. - Enter your address details and provide information on past and current academic qualifications. Upload the bonafide certificate. - Enter fee details and upload the fee receipt and textbook fee receipt (if applicable). - Provide parent/guardian details, family annual income information, and upload supporting documents such as income certificates and death certificates (if applicable). - Enter bank account details and upload the required banking and identity documents. - Complete the undertaking by downloading it through the e-sign process using Aadhaar authentication, then upload the signed undertaking. - Preview the application, submit it online, and receive a confirmation email upon successful submission. > **NOTE:** [**Student User Manual**](https://goascholar.dhe.goa.gov.in/Manual) **to know more about the application process.**

children.text: The applicant should not be more than 35 years of age as on 1 January of the year for which the scheme is disbursed.
The applicant should be a resident of Goa for a minimum period of 15 years.
The applicant who is of Goan origin may also apply, provided the applicant has resided in Goa for at least 7 years.
The applicant of Goan origin should submit proof that either parent or grandparent was born in Goa.
The applicant should have passed the qualifying degree examination from an institution, preferably located in Goa.
The applicant should have secured a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the qualifying degree examination.
The applicant should have obtained a minimum aggregate score of 70% as per the criteria prescribed under the scheme for shortlisting.
The applicant should be a bonafide student of the institution in which the applicant is pursuing a postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programme.
The applicant should be pursuing the postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programme during the academic year for which assistance is sought.
The applicant should provide a bonafide certificate mentioning the programme name and the start and end dates of study.
The applicant may pursue a postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programme in any discipline.

The applicant should provide rank, grade, position, or accreditation details if the institution is listed in QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education Rankings, National Institutional Ranking Framework rankings, or accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council.

children.text: Scholarship for Studies in India:
Financial assistance of ₹6,00,000 is provided to each selected scholar pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy studies in India.
Scholarship for Studies Abroad:
Financial assistance of ₹15,00,000 is provided to each selected scholar pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy studies abroad.
Number of Awards:
Up to 40 scholars are selected every year.
In exceptional circumstances, the number of awards may be increased.
The total number of awards shall not exceed 50 in a year.
Mode of Disbursement:
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented students from Goa, encourage admission to reputed institutions in India and abroad, and foster quality education, research, development, and innovation.

children.text: The "Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme, 2025" has been launched by the Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented students from Goa, encourage admission to reputed institutions in India and abroad, and strengthen quality education, research, development, and innovation. It provides financial assistance for studies in India and abroad to meritorious scholars pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programmes.
Objectives of the Scheme
To promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented youth of Goa.
To recognize and support meritorious and outstanding candidates.
To encourage admission in reputed institutions in India and abroad.
To motivate students to undertake cutting-edge research.
To promote quality education, research, development, and innovation.
To contribute towards sustainable development through human capital creation.
